propositions: Build and dry-run a committed operational script that uses stock Git plumbing (fast-export/fast-import with length-aware binary filtering) to rewrite ticket branch history, stripping .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes while preserving DAG topology and commit/merge counts.

The script must refuse to run on blob:none partial clones and require a fresh unfiltered --no-tags clone, verify absence of .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ at old tip before rewrite, and assert that target history (except dynamic re-add at HEAD) is completely removed.

After rewrite, dynamically re-add the current .bridge_state/ set using git ls-tree to ensure the new tree is byte-identical to the old tree, verify the local protected tag pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z is absent, and confirm rewritten pack size is at most 150 MB.

Parse fast-export data blocks by byte length (not line-based grep) to preserve commit messages that begin with M or D bytes, and use force-with-lease on publication (owned by A6-1) to detect concurrent remote movements.

The script must emit final success only after all graph/tree/history/immutability/tag/pack assertions complete, never push during dry run, and leave source remote branch and tag unchanged; a representative writer push after rewrite must succeed with <1 MiB incremental pack and old tip not an ancestor.

Verify no production push occurs, all 17 acceptance criteria are code-verifiable, unit tests cover binary stream framing with adversarial commit-message prefixes, and integration tests use temporary real Git repositories to prove refs/DAG/tree/reachability/pack behavior.
